summary.intent: Improve Cohezion's ability to model agents as Exotic Vacuum Objects (EVOs) by wiring the Quadrature Nexus → FLUME VAE → SurrealDB journey capture pipeline, then analyzing those journeys via Mycelium skill synthesis and Ouroboros anomaly detection to create a closed feedback loop that improves the system's own consensus quality. Scale it to run overnight, then use proper TDD/V-model methodology with multi-perspective adversarial review.
summary.outcome: The E57 additive calibration fix (SET → += semantics in apply_mycelium_feedback) was validated experimentally through E55-E64 and committed with 11 regression tests; the fix mathematically characterizes convergence as consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125×(1−lr/2)^n. 30+ test failures were fixed across arc, compound, core, and cache modules. PR #113 opened. The Mycelium→EVO closed loop was empirically proven: lr=2.0 crosses the HIHO threshold in one cycle (delta=+0.1250) and raises EVO coherence from 0.4337 to 0.4682.

repo: run_llm_deliberation() unconditionally SETs _score_adjustments[vt] = (llm_score - base) + mycelium_calib on every call, wiping any Mycelium adjustments before the next deliberation reads them — tests requiring Mycelium effect must call nexus.deliberate() directly
SurrealDB HTTP probe must use 'RETURN true;' — 'SELECT 1;' returns 400 in SurrealQL
SurrealDB SCHEMAFULL tables reject arbitrary nested metadata subfields; pack variable EVO biography data into option<string> result field as compact JSON
SurrealDB datetime fields require time::now() in CREATE statements — string literals like '2026-05-01T21:00:00Z' are rejected
Gemini worktrees (.gemini/worktrees/) are ephemeral and get cleaned up; never rely on them for persistent code changes
autoresearch.jsonl tracked by git causes pre-commit stash/restore conflicts when the overnight loop writes to it continuously — must remove from git tracking

_mycelium_calibration is the persistent accumulator; _score_adjustments is the read surface that _evaluate_* methods consume. run_llm_deliberation only resets _score_adjustments not _mycelium_calibration, making the two-layer model correct

The UCB1 exploration policy in arc/solver.py was used for both beam expansion AND best-answer selection — untested transforms (trials=0, UCB1=inf) always displaced confirmed-correct transforms from the beam
The compound psutil memory guardrail (silicon_guard.py) fires in CI environments with >80% RAM usage, blocking executor tests — requires autouse mock in tests/compound/conftest.py
asyncio.wait_for() with negative timeout value silently causes an infinite tight spin loop — must guard with max(30.0, remaining_s) before passing to wait_for
The DRR (Design Review Report) gate in executor.py was blocking skill refinement even for non-critical DRR failures — it should be advisory-only per the V-model

heuristic mode QuadratureNexus produces a single-attractor distribution (0.93 consensus from quad-silver proposals), making JEPA unable to learn — JEPA needs LLM-mode variance to accumulate meaningful gradients

code.finding: E57 fix: __init__ must initialize self._mycelium_calibration = dict.fromkeys(VoiceType, 0.0). apply_mycelium_feedback must use += (additive) not = (SET) so calibration compounds across cycles. Returns mechanism='additive_calibration'. Convergence formula: consensus_n = 0.85 − 0.125×(1−lr/2)^n, validated to max_error=0.00025

UCB1 bug: best_chain was determined by UCB1 score not actual score. Fix: before UCB1 sorting, track actual_best = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[1]) and update state.best_chain directly. UCB1 sorting should only drive beam expansion at deeper depths.

_find_project_root raises ContextLoadError when no .context directory exists. Fix: add fallback that returns the first ancestor containing pyproject.toml or CLAUDE.md, only raising if no fallback found.
DRR gate (drr_passed) was blocking skill_refiner.refine() when DRR failed. DRR is observability/review, not a feedback-loop gate. Fix: log advisory warning only, do not set should_refine = False.

vault_write is async but was called synchronously throughout. Fix: add _fire_vault_write() helper that uses loop.create_task() if running loop exists, falls back to asyncio.run() otherwise. Replace all 6 call sites.

red_team_veto only fired on keyword 'contradiction' in strategy string. create_contradiction injects physical impossibilities without that word. Fix: also set veto when all reviewer critiques contain 'CONTRADICTION: TRUE'.

Uses httpx.AsyncClient but tests patched httpx.Client — mock was never invoked. connect() needed auth error (403) distinction. Missing methods: vault_delete, vault_log_decision, vault_find_relevant_context. _call_tool content extraction requires 'type':'text' field in mock response.

Add autouse psutil mock: _MockVirtualMemory with percent=50.0, total=128GiB, available=64GiB, used=64GiB. silicon_guard.py accesses vm.total and vm.available — mock must include all three numeric fields.

test_pattern_extract_invert used 2x2 grid [[0,1],[1,0]]→[[1,0],[0,1]] which is solved by both flip_h (row reversal) AND invert. DFS finds flip_h first. Fix: use 3x3 asymmetric grid where invert is the only single-op solution.

_check_retirement must normalize SCHEDULE labels (e.g. 'E12_persist') to experiment keys (e.g. 'E12') via regex r'^(E\d+)' before querying autoresearch.jsonl. Retirement criteria: (A) n_keeps>=min_runs AND CV<0.05 for converged attractors; (B) n_total>=min_runs AND n_keeps==0 for confirmed noise.

workflow: ruff-format pre-commit hook rejects unstaged reformatting — always run 'uv run ruff format <file>' before staging or the commit will be rejected
Commit immediately after any important change — uncommitted work in Gemini worktrees or unstaged edits are at constant risk of silent loss
asyncio.run() is the correct wrapper for async methods in unittest.TestCase tests (not async def test_* which requires pytest-asyncio)
Patching async HTTP clients: use unittest.mock.patch('httpx.AsyncClient') not 'httpx.Client', and set post/aclose methods as AsyncMock
IEEE 754 edge case: sum([0.85]*n)/n < 0.85 in Python — use result.approved (direct float comparison) not mean-of-means to check threshold crossing
timeit.default_timer() is time.perf_counter() on Python 3.3+ — monotonic, sub-microsecond, immune to NTP corrections — correct for experiment wall-clock timing
Retirement criterion using CV(last-10 keeps) < 0.05 correctly identifies converged experiments; 0-keep experiments after N runs need a separate zero-keep criterion since CV is undefined with no keeps
Pre-existing test-ordering state leakage (8 compound tests) passes in isolation but fails in full suite — these require session-scoped fixture isolation investigation, not quick fixes
When a pre-commit hook fails because a runtime file (autoresearch.jsonl) has unsaved modifications conflicting with stash/restore, the fix is git rm --cached on that file and adding it to .gitignore
